text_block_list.text:
There's still some time before my
training session
with Фудзи Кисэки, so I
decide to take a walk around
campus.

Aaah!
Fujiii! ♪
text_block_list.name: Darling Ponies

text_block_list.text:
There, that should be good for the
lighting.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Welcome to the stage, dear pony. Now
tell me,
what kind of picture would you
like to take
together?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
U-um, I want something really daring!
One with
you looking fierce and
possessive, please!
text_block_list.name: Inspired Pony

text_block_list.text:
Hm... I'd much rather spoil you with
tender
sweetness...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
But if it's the thrill of feral danger you
want, then
come. I can be as dastardly
and roguish as you'd
like.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Aaaahhh! ♪
text_block_list.name: Darling Ponies
choice_data_list: What is she up to now?

text_block_list.text:
Huehuehue. ♪ If it isn't Fuji's trainer! I
can give
you all the deets! ♪
text_block_list.name: Агнес Диджитал

text_block_list.text:
Behold! This is none other than the fan
photo op
Fuji set up out of her
bottomless magnanimity!
text_block_list.name: Агнес Диджитал

text_block_list.text:
It all started when a particularly
passionate fan
asked to see Fuji in her
signature racewear close
up.
text_block_list.name: Агнес Диджитал

text_block_list.text:
But of course, my darling pony! Why
don't we
take a picture together while
we're at it?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
That way, you'll forever have a keepsake
to
remember when you stood next to me
in my
signature racewear.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Sigh... Fuji's generosity toward her fans knows no bounds...
text_block_list.name: Агнес Диджитал
choice_data_list: No wonder there's such a long line...

text_block_list.text:
Yep! Fuji's practically an A-list celebrity
with how
popular she is!
text_block_list.name: Агнес Диджитал

text_block_list.text:
If you want to get a picture with her,
you'd better
get in line fast! You never
know when the event'll
close!
text_block_list.name: Агнес Диджитал
choice_data_list: Might as well line up since I'm here...

text_block_list.text:
Hehehe! ♪ That's the spirit! A picture
with her
trainer is bound to pull at the
heartstrings! ♪
text_block_list.name: Агнес Диджитал

text_block_list.text:
As I get in line and wait for my turn with
Fuji
Kiseki, I reminisce about the day her
signature
racewear arrived.

Ta-dah! What do you think of my
signature
racewear, Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки
choice_data_list: It's great! You look just like a stage actor!

text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I'm glad my uniform's motif
came
through so clearly.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
My mother's an actor. She's performed
and sung
in countless productions,
mesmerizing her
audiences.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Since I was a child, her brilliance has
burned
bright in my heart. I may not
stand on the same
stage as her, but I'm
just as determined.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I want to be like her. One day, I want to
wear this
outfit and astound everyone
with a race so
wonderful it feels like a
dream.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
It's the reason I designed it to look like a
tuxedo,
fit for the stage.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки
choice_data_list:
Then let's build the most amazing stage for you
to stand on in your signature racewear!

text_block_list.text: Sounds like a plan!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Next in line, plea—
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Oh? What are you doing here, Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки
choice_data_list: I wanted to surprise you! Did it work?

text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! It certainly did! I wasn't
expecting you at
all. Come, let's take a
picture together!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Фудзи Кисэки takes me by the hand and
pulls me up
on the stage, where we take
a selfie.
choice_data_list: You look even more dazzling than usual.

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Perhaps it's because of my
signature
racewear.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Wearing this racewear doesn't simply
change my
appearance.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
It also enrobes me with firm
determination and
transforms me into a
sublime entertainer, capable
of creating
new worlds out of nothing.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I swear to you and upon this racewear of
mine...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I'll charm everyone with a performance
so
enthralling—a race so thrilling—they'll
never
forget it. And until I do, I'll never
stop running.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
When that dream of mine comes true,
will you
please be there with me to take
another picture
together?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, that was so dreamy! It sounded
just like a
marriage proposal!
text_block_list.name: Pony Bystander A

text_block_list.text:
Hehe... A proposal, eh? Well, Тренер?
What's
your answer?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки
choice_data_list: I do—I mean, y-yes, of course I will.

text_block_list.text:
Oh, so you're the type to watch and
support your
faves from afar, eh? That's
super valid too!
text_block_list.name: Агнес Диджитал

text_block_list.text:
I watch over Фудзи Кисэки until it's time for
our
training session, reminiscing about
the day her
signature racewear arrived.

Ta-dah! What do you think of my
signature
racewear, Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки
choice_data_list: It's great! You look just like a stage actor!

text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I'm glad my uniform's motif
came
through so clearly.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
My mother's an actor. She's performed
and sung
in countless productions,
mesmerizing her
audiences.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Since I was a child, her brilliance has
burned
bright in my heart. I may not
stand on the same
stage as her, but I'm
just as determined.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I want to be like her. One day, I want to
wear this
outfit and astound everyone
with a race so
wonderful it feels like a
dream.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
It's the reason I designed it to look like a
tuxedo,
fit for the stage.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки
choice_data_list:
Then let's build the most amazing stage for you
to stand on in your signature racewear!

text_block_list.text: Sounds like a plan!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I come out of my musings and realize it's
nearly
time for our training session to
begin.
choice_data_list: Fuji, it's time to get training.

text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer. I didn't realize it was so late
already.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Nooo! You're going already? But I
wanted to get
a selfie with you!
text_block_list.name: Gloomy Pony

text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, dear pony. I wish there was
some way I
could make it up to you...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Aha! Trainer, would it be all right if I
trained in my
signature racewear today?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for having to leave so soon, but
I'll run
my heart out for you today in my
signature
racewear, darlings. Won't you
stay and watch
over me, please?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Eeek! Of course we will!
text_block_list.name: Hopeful Pony

text_block_list.text: Do your best, Fujiii! We love youuu!
text_block_list.name: Darling Ponies

text_block_list.text:
Thank you, my dear ponies! I'll be off
now, so be
good.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
(With this signature racewear and my
skills, I'll
lead everyone into a lustrous
future, brimming
with never-ending
applause! I swear it!)
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Keep your eyes on me, Mother. I'll make
sure the
future is so bright, its light
reaches even your
stage!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Фудзи Кисэки runs with renewed resolve,
and even if
they don't realize it, her
audience is treated to
the glimpse of a
miracle that day.

As delighted shrieks ring out from the
waiting
crowd around us, I can't help but
think that Fuji
Kiseki's charisma is
downright dangerous.
